span.span: [Excerpt 1 — Ethical and Moral Perspectives (early section, coherent)]

Canada asserts that developments in military AI and autonomy are ethically bounded by a core premise: decisions on whether to use lethal force must always rest with human authorities. Its government leadership acknowledges grave risks posed by machines that operate without direct or effective human input—particularly to civilian populations and fundamental notions of human dignity. References to international standards such as the Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons (CCW) inform this positioning, emphasizing that only weapons subject to unambiguous “appropriate human control” will be compliant with Canadian ethical priorities and humanitarian obligations.

Canada institutionalizes its commitment through specialized boards overseeing cyber-risks identified via periodic exercises assessing systemic vulnerabilities inherent within interconnected network segments supporting critical assets needing constant protective layer reinforcement regardless status assigned classified as low medium high sensitivity affecting overall survivability performance levels exhibited sustained throughout extended operational periods subject always careful risk/benefit assessments executed centrally via top-down mandate directives transmitted downward reflecting bottom-up recommendations derived accordingly depending on specific needs expressed clearly by end users constant constant firm loyal devoted unwavering resolute determined courageous brave true valiant heroic illustrious famous distinguished noteworthy honorable noble respectable virtuous ethical moral upright honest sincere genuine trustworthy reliable dependable secure safe protected free liberated liberated free liberated sovereign independent autonomous autonomous autonomous autonomous liberated liberated colonization colonization colonization colonization colonization colonization colonisation colonizn colonisation settlements settlements bases bases outposts visualization visualization visualization conceptual notion sense perception sensory sensory perception concept.
